verdict.rationale: Resend documents receiving inbound email: you point MX records at Resend, process messages via webhooks, and can list received emails. Nothing in the evidence shows rule-based routing, meaning matching on recipient or pattern and then forwarding, storing, or POSTing to different endpoints per rule. Inbound receipt through a webhook is an adjacent capability, not the routing-rules feature the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can route inbound mail with rules — match on recipient or pattern and forward, store, or POST to different endpoints
